free_tier.stated: 10 GB of free storage since the end of February 2026 (previously 1 TB). Files above the new quota are not deleted; only new uploads are restricted.

retention.stated: A free account that stays inactive for 3 consecutive months can have its files removed after prior notification.

egress.terms: Free accounts get 10 GB of traffic per day (previously 100 GB per month).

interface_detail: WebDAV (beta, announced May 2025), enabled on the website; directories can be read-only or read/write.

limits.value: 10 GB free storage; new uploads are restricted above the quota, existing files are kept

limits_note: The App Store lists Premium at 3,99 EUR monthly or 28,49 EUR yearly (in-app purchase); the price of extra storage is unverified: not published on a captured page.
